article.title: Partnership at will.
article.content: Where no provision is made by contract between the partners for the duration of their partnership or for the determination of their partnership, the partnership is “partnership at will”.
article.html:
7Partnership at will.

Section 7 · Chapter II · page 5 of the Act

Where no provision is made by contract between the partners for the duration of their partnership or for the determination of their partnership, the partnership is “partnership at will”.
